title: What if his snoring got twice as loud every night?
caption:
Night 1: annoying. Night 10: louder than a jet engine. 😴🔊
And he still says he doesn't snore. Stay or couch? 👇
note: Twice as loud = about +10 dB: night 1 60 dB, 3 80 dB, 5 100 dB, 7 120 dB (thunder), 10 150 dB (a jet engine up close is ~140 dB).
first_comment: Be honest: who's the snorer in your relationship? Tag them 😴
